column1: # One-hex displacements, applied after ports.tsv is mapped onto the grid.
# The source reference rounds port positions to 5 degrees, and at that
# granularity four pairs collide outright: it gives Hamburg and Oslo the same
# N65 E5, Naples and Pisa the same N45 E10, Marseille and Tunis the same
# N40 E5, and Genoa and Venice the same N50 E10. Two ports in one hex cannot
# both be drawn or both be sailed to.
# ports.tsv stays a faithful transcription of the source. The correction lives
# here instead, so the two can be told apart and the reasoning is on the page.
# In each pair the port moved is the one that really does lie in that direction
# from the other, so the map ends up slightly more right than the table it came
# dcol and drow are offsets in odd-r offset coordinates.
